patch.value: Stop predeclared evaluations safely at sequential boundaries

Extend sealed evaluation plans with reviewed sequential stopping. Acceptance: deterministic null and benefit simulations validate the declared error bound; seal the rule before collection; fixed plans preserve behavior; saved checkpoints resume without recounting. Include typed SDK and CLI, compact reports, typed remedies, model-based replay tests, boundary interleavings and read-only public tracker evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check on current CLI 2026.10.25 and sibling package source/docs: pm-rl-evalplans explicitly seals fixed stopping; core SDK exposes tracker transactions and locks, not sequential statistics; pm-jev owns inference receipts, pm-context context selection, pm-rlm inference recursion. No existing alpha-spending evaluation protocol found. This extends pm-rl evaluation plans, retaining promotion approval and contamination gates. Design: predeclared finite looks over frozen complete correlation units, two-sided Hoeffding alpha spending, reviewed rule identity, immutable append-only checkpoint chain with SDK writer serialization and current provenance checks on every retry. No import/export/sync subsystem or status-name classification is introduced.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented reviewed finite-look plans, cumulative immutable checkpoint chaining, advance/resume CLI and promotion bindings. Seeded 10,000-trial null/benefit simulations measured zero false efficacy and zero false futility decisions at the declared 0.05 bound; all 10,000 benefit trials stopped early. Targeted real SDK tests pass for restart, old snapshot retries, changed candidate provenance, futility and exhaustion. A 500-sequence SDK model test is running. Production typecheck, lint, duplication and docstrings pass so far; full npm/Bun release evidence will use CI as instructed.

value.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="strict sequential|only complete|null, benefit|boundary input|output validation" test/sequential-evaluation.test.ts

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read-only public tracker validation passed using the installed packed CLI with Git absent from PATH. Public source commit 120e20e160897cabe47920713e1b87b6647b2e85: 107 items, 87 done-role items using the SDK status registry, candidate mean 0.8130841121495327 vs incumbent 0.1869158878504673. One repository remains one unit; exhausted/refuse, no promotion. JSON 853 bytes; TOON 730 bytes; one checkpoint, exact restart, source digest unchanged. Linked pm tests pass 3/3 (five focused regressions, typecheck, lint); configured tracking is disabled, so the receipt is recorded here. Behavioral revert controls: removing uncertainty fails null simulation; returning the requested old checkpoint fails restart/old-input regression; restored implementation passes 2/2. All 29 existing fixed-plan tests pass. No core dependency pins, thresholds or history records changed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final implementation correction: retain explicit sequential-kind validation at the SDK boundary and pass its typed rule into internal checkpoint reads; fixed-plan advance/resume now return typed stopping refusals. Regression tests pass 4/4 including 22 registration interleavings and 2 publication boundaries. Earlier checkpoint interleavings passed at 34 SDK boundaries. New promotion tests refuse missing or foreign checkpoints. The superseded initial CI run was canceled after this deterministic refusal-path defect was found; cancellation is not gate evidence. Final code-head CI must pass all three complete release checks before handoff. External review has no approval: CodeRabbit skips under repository policy, Sourcery is budget-limited, Greptile trial expired; zero inline findings.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional concurrency hardening found during final audit: hold native SDK locks on every predecessor checkpoint through dependent checkpoint publication, so an ordinary SDK writer cannot change a predecessor into a foreign record after validation. This prevents a dependent write before returning a skip. A new real-peer test injects the mutation immediately before and after publication, then verifies foreign state is observed after lease release. Superseding the prior code-head CI run; only the eventual complete final-head run will count as gate evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Predecessor-race and asynchronous SDK intake tests pass 2/2 on the restored implementation. Removing only predecessor locks makes the real-peer regression fail; restoring them passes. Canonical observations are now copied before asynchronous provenance reads, preventing caller mutation from changing the look or observations after lock selection. Local typecheck, test typecheck, lint, zero-duplication and 416 documented declarations pass. Final release CI will execute the complete 500-sequence model with live SDK state, relationships and custom statuses; previous canceled runs are not acceptance evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Orchestrator read-only review blocks PR 107: unvalidated dependency identifiers can reach native lock cleanup before plan rejection. Extending scope to the identifier-validation and state-path confinement class across the package, with real SDK must-allow/must-refuse property coverage, external tripwires, symlink checks and a boundary-validation revert proof. Existing evaluation implementation and prior gate evidence are retained; new code requires a new exact-head npm/Bun gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented a single strict identifier boundary, SDK-delegating client guard, confined state-path helper and native lease wrapper. Routed controller/item leases, artifacts, LM checkpoints, trainer staging and dataset outputs. Initial targeted security suite passes 3/3: 500 seeded invalid/valid sequences, reported expired external-lock traversal, symlinked roots/directories/leaves/cleanup gates, tripwire hashes and successor-token preservation. Compatibility and independent bypass review remain in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Boundary-only revert proof: removed only the shared identifier validator body, leaving path confinement and production functions intact. The seeded security property failed with Missing expected exception (exit 1). Restoring the validator passes all 3 security tests. External tree-hash tripwires and the expired external review lock remain intact. Independent compatibility review also found and fixed settlement after path refusals; native recovery now expires the observed open inode/token and delegates removal to the SDK cleanup lease.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Compatibility checks preserve opaque content-addressed score contexts as a distinct strict schema variant; digests can never become filesystem components or native item references. SDK-only promotion keeps its existing no-process-tool path. The pinned test runner still reserves sandbox PM_PATH and rejects env-clear PM_PATH; linked tests therefore cover pure/path boundaries, while real SDK tracker tests run directly and in CI. No upstream repository changes were made.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Security validation complete locally: 50/50 focused evaluation and security tests, 9/9 checkpoint/staging checks, 5/5 raw-reference regressions, and the controller recovery scenarios including process takeover, worktree authority and malformed locks pass after the fixes. The 500-sequence security property additionally checks raw stored parent/approval/environment/run references and SDK relationship identifiers. Validation-only revert fails cleanly with Missing expected exception; restored security suite passes 3/3 with 100% targeted boundary-module line/branch/function coverage. Typecheck, test typecheck, lint, documented declarations and zero duplication pass. Full npm/Bun release evidence will come from the PR CI checks; existing public-data evidence is retained unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final path review adds typed refusal for malformed state roots (empty, non-string, NUL or more than 4096 UTF-8 bytes). Ancestor lstat checks reject links without relying on platform-specific physical-path spelling. Tripwire hashes now include directory/file modes, inodes, sizes and modification/change timestamps plus link targets; the release tripwire is a sibling of the state root. All 3 security tests still pass with 100% targeted boundary coverage. Initial CI run 40296685065 is queued; it will be superseded by the final hardening head.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The final transaction entry point validates transaction and step identifiers before recovery touches the workspace lock, and standalone fences validate their state root before process probing. The restored security suite passes 3/3, including 500 invalid transaction retries, with boundary-module 100% line/branch/function coverage; typecheck, test typecheck, lint and 426 documented declarations pass.
